notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Voyaging Satyr.
Voyaging Satyr does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Lotus Field.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
Repeat.
